data.introEn: SSEF 200 Index consists of top 200 SSE-listed stocks ranked by fundamental value, which is calculated by 4 financial factors (Revenue, Cash Flow, Book Value and Dividends). And the weights of constituents are also decided by the fundamental value rather than the capitalization.
